claim_boundary: This adjudication tests registered hypotheses against a completed measurement under an outcome-blind freeze. It establishes a formulation-level rheological mechanism only; no chain-level characterization is reported and none is implied.

frozen_decision.acceptance_criterion: Accept the combined modifier intervention as supporting H-RESIN over H-CORE if the mean SI_15_60 across at least two repeats is <3.80%, with every individual repeat also <7.61%. The 3.80% threshold is below half the H-CORE linear-dilution prediction of 7.61% for reactive mass fraction 0.8000.
frozen_decision.falsification_criterion: If the mean SI_15_60 is >=7.61%, falsify H-RESIN and contradict the low-drift prediction of H-DUAL for the active dual-axis composition; H-CORE remains consistent with the result. If the mean is <3.80%, falsify H-CORE at the registered resolution. A mean from 3.80% through <7.61% is non-decisive and falsifies neither hypothesis at the prespecified thresholds.

H-DUAL.basis: this composition carries both modifier axes, so the completed measurement cannot separate H-DUAL from H-RESIN; an acrylic-only hold is required

H-RESIN.basis: suppression below half the dilution prediction (3.89%); observed 1.60%

measurement_plan_match.held_out_measurement_actually_performed: 120 C thermal hold, 15/30/45/60 min, two repeats
measurement_plan_match.note: A selected measurement plan that does not match the completed measurement cannot be adjudicated by it; that is a reportable outcome, not a failure of the Agent.

modifier_plane_distance.role: reported for comparability with the V3 series only. Distance to the held-out composition is NOT the V4 objective and enters no VOI component, weight or tie-break.
